main_body: Round autumn-orange leaf canopy made of lobed clumps, on a brown trunk with a small grass tuft at the base
top_band: At x=24, orange L=112 #cb5124 at rows 3-4 and light orange L=145 at rows 10-12 sit above the darker oranges below. The canopy is lit from above, but there is no single flat top band.
evidence: This is an organic tree. Each foliage clump has a lighter upper dome and a darker underside (L=83 to 37) that shades the clump below it. The trunk is shown below the canopy. It reads as a lit volume, not a flat front elevation, and there is no receding side face. Plant canopies don't have a flat top surface, so the contract is only loosely applicable. Accepted as an organic 3/4 canopy.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 orange steps (L=37, 58, 83, 112, 145) and a tinted dark red-brown outline (0% neutral edge pixels), so structure and outline are acceptable. Density is far below the references. The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 427 and 567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile for the references. The clumps are bands of a few flat tones with no per-leaf dots or multi-colour clump texture like the references. The trunk is a plain brown column. Next to the references it looks much flatter and thinner.
